An '''iron pickaxe''' is the [[Iron equipment|iron]] [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]], crafted from [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. It mines at speed 7 and has 500 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/iron_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines pickaxe blocks at speed 7 (vanilla: 6).

It mines every ore but cannot get drops from obsidian, crying obsidian or ender chests, which it breaks at speed 3.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/iron.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 4 damage with an attack speed of 1.2.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/iron_ingot_from_blasting_iron_materials.json}}</ref>
